arxiv-2306-09058.title: Subcubic graphs of large treewidth do not have the edge-Erdős-Pósa property
arxiv-2306-09058.creator: Henning Bruhn, Raphael Steck
arxiv-2306-09058.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Henning Bruhn, Raphael Steck. We show that subcubic graphs of treewidth at least 2500 2500 do not have the edge-Erdős-Pósa property. 1 Introduction Menger’s theorem provides a strong duality between packing and covering for paths: In every graph G , there are either k disjoint paths between predefined sets A,B\subseteq V(G) , or there is a set X\subseteq V(G) of size at most k such that G-X contains no A – B path.

arxiv-2310-05190.title: Scalar field perturbation around a rotating hairy black hole: quasinormal modes, quasibound states and superradiant instability
arxiv-2310-05190.creator: Yun-He Lei, Zhen-Hao Yang, Xiao-Mei Kuang
arxiv-2310-05190.description: Abstract We consider the quasinormal modes, quasibound states and superradiant instability of a rotating hairy black hole, which possesses a Horndeski hair as deviation from Kerr black hole, under the perturbation of massive scalar field. With the use of the matrix method, we mainly calculate the eigenfrequencies related to those modes of the perturbation.

arxiv-2407-13381.title: First Direct Evidence for Keplerian Rotation in Quasar Inner Broad Line Regions
arxiv-2407-13381.creator: C. Fian, J. Jiménez-Vicente, E. Mediavilla, J. A. Muñoz, D. Chelouche, S. Kaspi, R. Forés-Toribio
arxiv-2407-13381.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by C. Fian, J. Jiménez-Vicente, E. Mediavilla, J. A. Muñoz, D. Chelouche, S. Kaspi, R. Forés-Toribio. We introduce a novel method to derive rotation curves with light-day spatial resolution of the inner regions of lensed quasars. We aim to probe the kinematics of the inner part of the broad-line region (BLR) by resolving the microlensing response – a proxy for the size of the emitting region – in the wings of the broad emission lines (BELs).

arxiv-2501-18505.title: Path Planning and Optimization for Cuspidal 6R Manipulators
arxiv-2501-18505.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . A cuspidal robot can move from one inverse kinematics (IK) solution to another without crossing a singularity. Multiple industrial robots are cuspidal. They tend to have a beautiful mechanical design, but they pose path planning challenges. A task-space path may have a valid IK solution for each point along the path, but a continuous joint-space path may depend on the choice of the IK solution or even be infeasible.

arxiv-2503-03604.title: Evolution of human cognition required Einstein’s gravitational waves
arxiv-2503-03604.creator: Bernard F. Schutz, Tsvi Piran, Patrick J. Sutton
arxiv-2503-03604.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Bernard F. Schutz, Tsvi Piran, Patrick J. Sutton. We describe an unexpected anthropic fine-tuning of gravity: human cognition arose on Earth only because the laws of gravity included gravitational waves. Their link is the heat from decays of the radioactive isotopes 238 U and 232 Th, which were synthesized mainly in rare explosive mergers of binary neutron stars, brought about by the loss of orbital energy to gravitational radiation.

arxiv-2507-07749.title: A Model-Free Extremum Seeking Controller with Application to Tracking a Nonlinear Chemical Reaction
arxiv-2507-07749.creator: Alexander Zuyev, Victoria Grushkovska
arxiv-2507-07749.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop the extremum-seeking approach to generate admissible trajectories in a neighborhood of a given reference curve in the state space. The cost function of the problem represents the distance between the current system state and the reference curve, which is parameterized as a function of time.

arxiv-2511-04943.title: Positive solutions of elliptic systems with superlinear nonlinearities on the boundary Thanks: Corresponding author: M. Chhetri (m_chhetr@uncg.edu)
arxiv-2511-04943.creator: Shalmali Bandyopadhyay, Maya Chhetri, Briceyda B. Delgado, Nsoki Mavinga, Rosa Pardo
arxiv-2511-04943.description: Abstract . We consider elliptic systems with superlinear and subcritical boundary conditions and a bifurcation parameter as a multiplicative factor. By combining the rescaling method with degree theory and elliptic regularity theory, we prove the existence of a connected branch of positive weak solutions that bifurcates from infinity as the parameter approaches zero.

pmc-11353940.title: DNA Methylation of Postnatal Liver Development in Pigs
pmc-11353940.creator: Yuhao Wang, Hongling Jin, Xingyan Tong, Huan Yu, Xuewei Li, Bo Zeng
pmc-11353940.description: DNA methylation plays an important role in the development and tissue differentiation of eukaryotes. pmc-13265687.creator: Neema Mduma, Hudson Laizer
pmc-13265687.description: Common bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) is an important food and cash crop in Tanzania, where it contributes to household nutrition and income among smallholder farmers. Its production is, however, constrained by diseases such as bean rust and bean anthracnose, which can cause substantial yield losses and reduce crop quality.

pmc-13294203.title: Structural basis for the ion selectivity of potassium-chloride cotransporter KCC4 revealed by cryo-EM titration
pmc-13294203.creator: Yuan Xie, Binming Han, Xin Tao, Fangjun Song, Cheng Zhao, Eric Delpire, Jingyuan Li, Shan Wu, Jiangtao Guo
pmc-13294203.description: Potassium-chloride cotransporters KCCs mediate the coupled, electroneutral cotransport of K+ and Cl− across the membrane and are involved in important physiological processes such as cell volume regulation and γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and glycine-mediated inhibitory neurotransmission. Although structures of KCCs have been reported, the identification of ions bound in KCCs awaits experimental studies.

pmc-13299594.title: Rapid and Robust Generation of Human Cortical Interneurons from Induced Neural Stem Cells
pmc-13299594.creator: Xinwei Zang, Yunqian Guan, Wanting Xing, Zhiguo Chen
pmc-13299594.description: Current protocols for generating cortical interneurons from human pluripotent stem cells are hindered by slow differentiation kinetics and poor reproducibility across cell lines. Here, we present a defined small-molecule-based strategy that efficiently directs human-induced neural stem cells (hiNSCs) toward cortical GABAergic interneurons within 14–18 days, which is substantially faster than conventional methods.
